required_disclosures.detail: Funding uses the independently frozen v1 snapshot; it was not rebuilt or vendor-checksum-audited by the V3 market-data process.
SOL, ZEC, NEAR, and FIL retain two official vendor gap windows; no synthetic, interpolated, resampled, or forward-filled bars were added.

Replay identity includes the repaired completed-window scanner, exact-correlation/journal, and protective-stop risk sources; it is not an exact historical replay of the already-running pre-repair PID image.
Point-in-time Fear & Greed is absent, so F&G-dependent gates allow rather than reject; the direction of this bias is unknown.
VSA preserves the deployed confirmation-close plus/minus 2 ATR fallback instead of claiming a repaired structural stop.
The YAML exit_engine block is inert for the deployed wrapper; the replay follows the wrapper's authoritative 30/30/40 partial-exit path.
Next-bar open plus fixed costs is a research proxy, not an exchange fill claim.
Historical L1, order queue, post-only fallback, and submission latency are absent.
Historical tick/lot rounding, minimum-notional changes, and margin tiers are absent.
Historical exchange availableBalance is absent; wallet and margin availability are modelled by the preregistered portfolio proxy.
Trailing-stop and runner time-stop decisions use completed bars, not the live intrabar mark sampling path.

concentration.basis_note: Entry concentration uses filled entry notional; PnL concentration uses absolute closed-episode net PnL attributed descriptively to final-exit month.
